name: VESupportEngine
description:
Engine that constraints given bodies in place (refPos) with a visco-elastic constrain according to the Burgers model. 

.. figure:: fig/rheological-scheme.*
	:width: 3cm

Burger's rheological scheme with adopted designations. 

The model of applied constraint can be degenerated to simpler models....

attributes.name: bIds
attributes.description: IDs of bodies that should be attached to supports.

attributes.name: c1
attributes.description: Damping coeff. of dashpot #1 (the one in Maxwell branch). Negative value turns off the dashpot. [N*s/m]

attributes.name: c2
attributes.description: Damping coeff. of dashpot #2 (the one in Kelvin-Voigt branch). Negative value turns off whole Kelvin-Voigt branch. [N*s/m]

attributes.name: k1
attributes.description: Stiffness of spring #1 (the one in Maxwell branch) [N/m]

attributes.name: k2
attributes.description: Stiffness of spring #2 (the one in Kelvin-Voigt branch) [N/m]
